<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use App\Models\{Order, Product, Category, User, Review};

class BenchmarkController  extends Controller
{

    public function orders()
    {
        return Order::all()->map(fn ($o) => [
            'id' => $o->id,
            'user' => $o->user->name,
            'items_count' => $o->items->count(),
        ]);
    }

    public function orderShow(Order $order)
    {
        return [
            'id' => $order->id,
            'user' => $order->user->name,
            'items' => $order->items->map(fn ($item) => [
                'product' => $item->product->label,
            ]),
        ];
    }

    public function enterpriseOrder()
    {
        $order = Order::where('number', 'ENT-00001')->firstOrFail();
        return [
            'id' => $order->id,
            'items' => $order->items->map(fn ($item) => [
                'product' => $item->product->label,
            ]),
        ];
    }

    public function products()
    {
        return Product::all()->map(fn ($p) => [
            'label' => $p->label,
            'category' => optional($p->category)->label,
        ]);
    }

    public function productsByCategory(Category $category)
    {
        return Product::where('category_id', $category->id)->get();
    }

    public function productReviews(Product $product)
    {
        return $product->reviews->map(fn ($r) => [
            'rating' => $r->rating,
            'user' => $r->user->name,
        ]);
    }

    public function productsWithoutCategory()
    {
        return Product::whereNull('category_id')->get();
    }

    public function categoryProducts(Category $category)
    {
        return $category->products->map(fn ($p) => [
            'label' => $p->label,
            'reviews_count' => $p->reviews->count(),
        ]);
    }

    public function userOrders(User $user)
    {
        return $user->orders->map(fn ($o) => [
            'number' => $o->number,
            'items_count' => $o->items->count(),
        ]);
    }

    public function recentReviews()
    {
        return Review::latest()->take(20)->get()->map(fn ($r) => [
            'product' => $r->product->label,
            'user' => $r->user->name,
        ]);
    }
}

input.reason: Without eager loading, each order triggers a separate query for $o->user and another for $o->items (1 + 2N queries). Eager loading 'user' and 'items' collapses this to 3 total queries.
Route-model-bound order triggers lazy loads for user, items, and each item's product (1 + 1 + N queries). Eager loading 'user' and 'items.product' reduces this to 3 queries total.
Accessing $order->items and then $item->product for each item causes an N+1 (1 query for the order, 1 for items, N for products). Eager loading 'items.product' makes it 3 queries total.
Product::all() followed by $p->category per product triggers N+1 queries. Eager loading 'category' reduces it to 2 total queries.
Lazy-loading $product->reviews and then $r->user for each review causes N+1. Using the query builder with 'user' eager loaded reduces it to 2 queries.
Lazy-loading $category->products and then $p->reviews for each product causes N+1 queries. Eager loading 'reviews' on the products query reduces it to 2 total queries.
Lazy-loading $user->orders and then $o->items for each order causes N+1 queries. Using the query builder with 'items' eager loaded reduces it to 2 total queries.
Each review triggers a lazy load for $r->product and $r->user (1 + 2N queries). Eager loading 'product' and 'user' reduces it to 3 queries total.
